mathematical_anchors.heading: Theorem PK — primitive-character Kummer rigidity
mathematical_anchors.source_statement_excerpt: Let \[ C/K:\quad \mathcal F(X,Y)=0, \] and let \[ K(C) \] be its function field. mathematical_anchors.heading: Theorem ID — universal cyclic interior descent
mathematical_anchors.source_statement_excerpt: Let `A` be a sufficiently large cyclic primitive triangle-free global minimizer of cardinality `n` and diameter \[ D=D(n). \] Let \[ Z:=A\setminus V(F), \qquad |Z|=n-q. \] Then \[ \boxed{ \operatorname{dist}(z,\partial F)>\frac{\sqrt3}{2} \qquad(z\in Z).} \tag{ID.1} \] Consequently \[ \boxed{ \operatorname{diam}Z<D-\sqrt3,} \tag{ID.2} \] and therefore the global optimum values satisfy \[ \boxed{ D(n-q)<D(n)-\sqrt3.} \tag{ID.3} \] This holds in all three cyclic diameter-topology phases. Because RP gives \[ q=\pi D-\frac\pi{24D}+O(D^{-2}), \tag{ID.4} \] ID is an exact one-step descent on the asymptotically natural shell scale: deleting approximately `pi D` source points decreases achievable diameter by strictly more than `sqrt(3)`. ---
